goal.en: Ask Sam to show you the order system, and thank him the right way.
goal.zh: 請山姆教你用訂單系統，並用對的方式道謝。

background: open-plan office with rows of white desks, desktop monitors with blank screens, small desk plants, smart desk lamps, a pair of headphones on a desk, large windows, late morning light

intro.en: Ms. Wong wants three café orders in the order system by today. There's just one problem: you've never used it.
intro.zh: 王經理要你今天把三筆咖啡廳訂單輸入訂單系統。只有一個問題：你從來沒用過這套系統。

intro.en: Sam is at his desk, typing fast with his headphones on. You walk over.
intro.zh: 山姆戴著耳機坐在位子上，正飛快地打字。你走了過去。

choices.en: Hey, Sam. Do you have a minute? I could use some help with the order system.
choices.zh: 嘿，山姆，你有空一下嗎？訂單系統的事想請你幫個忙。
choices.tip: Do you have a minute? 先確認對方有沒有空，再說明需求，是請人幫忙的禮貌開場。

choices.en: Sam, you have time or not? I have a big problem, I want to ask you something.
choices.zh: 山姆，你有沒有空？我有個大問題想問你。

lines.en: A big problem? Oh no. Is everything okay? Should I call IT?
lines.zh: 大問題？糟了。一切都還好嗎？要不要叫 IT？

story.en: Sam panics and calls IT. Five minutes later, three people are standing around your desk, waiting for the "big problem."
story.zh: 山姆一緊張就叫了 IT。五分鐘後，三個人圍在你的座位旁，等著看那個「大問題」。

fail.why: 「你有沒有空」直譯成 have time or not 很生硬，「有個問題」說成 have a big problem 又像出了大事。說 Do you have a minute? I could use some help. 就好。

choices.en: Sam, stop working for a second. You need to teach me the order system.
choices.zh: 山姆，先停一下手邊的工作。你要教我用訂單系統。

lines.en: I "need to"? I'm kind of in the middle of something, Kai.
lines.zh: 我「要」教你？我現在手邊正在忙耶，凱。

story.en: Sam puts his headphones back on. You spend the morning watching tutorial videos with the volume on low.
story.zh: 山姆把耳機戴回去。你整個早上只能把音量調小，自己看教學影片。

fail.why: You need to... 加上命令句，聽起來像在下指令。請人幫忙要先問：Do you have a minute?，再說 I could use some help.。

lines.en: Sure, but I've got a client call in ten minutes. What do you need?
lines.zh: 好啊，不過我十分鐘後要跟客戶通電話。你需要什麼？

choices.en: I need to enter three orders. Could you just show me the first one?
choices.zh: 我要輸入三筆訂單。可以先示範第一筆給我看嗎？
choices.tip: 對方時間不多時，把請求縮小成 just the first one，對方更容易答應。

choices.en: Ten minutes? Oh, who is your call with? Is it a big client? Which company?
choices.zh: 十分鐘？喔，你要跟誰通電話？是大客戶嗎？哪家公司？

lines.en: It's... with a hotel, yeah. Wait, what did you need again?
lines.zh: 是……一家飯店啦。等等，你剛剛是要什麼？

story.en: By the time Sam finishes telling you about his call, it's time for his call. Your orders stay empty until tomorrow.
story.zh: 等山姆跟你講完他的電話，他的電話也到了。你的訂單一直空白到隔天。

fail.why: 對方說只有十分鐘，就要直接說需求：I need to enter three orders. Could you show me the first one?。好奇心留到之後。

choices.en: I need enter three orders. Can you teach me how to using it?
choices.zh: 我要輸入三筆訂單。你可以教我怎麼用嗎？

lines.en: How to... using? Sorry, do you need to use it, or are you using it?
lines.zh: 怎麼……using？抱歉，你是要用，還是正在用？

story.en: Sam spends five minutes figuring out what you need and only five minutes showing you. You remember about half of it.
story.zh: 山姆花五分鐘搞懂你要什麼，只剩五分鐘示範。你大概只記得一半。

fail.why: need 後面要加 to：I need to enter...；how to 後面接原形動詞：how to use it。

lines.en: Okay, first you click New Order, then you pick the client from this list. Clear so far?
lines.zh: 好，先按 New Order，再從這個清單選客戶。到這裡清楚嗎？

choices.en: Sorry, could you go back one step? I missed where the client list was.
choices.zh: 不好意思，可以退回上一步嗎？我沒看到客戶清單在哪。
choices.tip: 沒跟上時直接說 Could you go back one step?，比假裝懂更有效率。

choices.en: Yes, yes, very clear. You explain so well. I understand everything.
choices.zh: 清楚、清楚，非常清楚。你解釋得超好，我全部都懂。

lines.en: Wait, you said it was clear. Why are all three orders under the wrong hotel?
lines.zh: 等等，你不是說很清楚嗎？為什麼三筆訂單都掛在錯的飯店底下？

story.en: A hotel receives forty café lamps it never ordered. Sam spends his afternoon on the phone fixing it.
story.zh: 一家飯店收到四十盞從沒訂過的咖啡廳吊燈。山姆整個下午都在打電話善後。

fail.why: 怕麻煩對方而假裝聽懂，最後反而造成更大的麻煩。沒跟上就說 Sorry, could you go back one step?。

choices.en: Slowly, slowly! Can you say again one more time? You are too fast for me.
choices.zh: 慢一點、慢一點！可以再說一次嗎？你太快了。

lines.en: Again one more time? So... twice? Okay, but I really have to go after this.
lines.zh: 再一次再一次？所以……講兩次？好吧，但講完我真的得走了。

story.en: Sam explains it twice, very slowly, and runs to his call. He never gets to the Submit button.
story.zh: 山姆非常慢地講了兩遍，然後衝去講電話。他根本沒講到送出按鈕。

fail.why: 「再說一次」直譯成 say again one more time 重複了。說 Could you say that again? 或 Could you go back one step?。

lines.en: And that's it. Then you click Submit. Want to try the next one yourself?
lines.zh: 就這樣，最後按 Submit。下一筆要不要自己試試看？

choices.en: Sure, I'll try. I'd really appreciate it if you could check it after your call.
choices.zh: 好，我試試看。如果你講完電話能幫我檢查一下，我會很感激。
choices.tip: I'd really appreciate it if you could... 是很客氣的請求句型，注意 it 不能省略。

choices.en: Okay, I try it. I will appreciate if you can help me to check it after your call.
choices.zh: 好，我試試看。如果你講完電話能幫我檢查，我會很感激。

lines.en: You'll appreciate... what? Sorry, check what, after what?
lines.zh: 你會感激……什麼？抱歉，檢查什麼？在什麼之後？

story.en: Sam runs off to his call still puzzled. Nobody checks your order, and it goes out with 100 lamps instead of 10.
story.zh: 山姆一臉困惑地跑去講電話。沒人幫你檢查，訂單送出時，十盞燈變成了一百盞。

fail.why: appreciate 後面一定要有受詞，要說 I'd really appreciate it if you could...；「我試試看」是 I'll try，不是 I try it。

choices.en: No, you do it. You're faster than me, and I'll just watch one more time.
choices.zh: 不要，你來做。你比我快，我再看一次就好。

lines.en: Kai, my call starts in two minutes. You've got to try it yourself.
lines.zh: 凱，我的電話兩分鐘後就開始了。你得自己試試看。

story.en: Sam leaves for his call. You stare at the screen, too nervous to press anything until he gets back an hour later.
story.zh: 山姆去講電話了。你盯著螢幕，緊張到什麼都不敢按，直到一個小時後他回來。

fail.why: 對方已經教你了，還要他幫你做，會顯得不想學。說 Sure, I'll try.，再請對方之後幫忙檢查。

lines.en: After his call, Sam checks your work.
lines.zh: 講完電話後，山姆檢查了你的成果。

lines.en: All three look perfect. You're a fast learner, Kai!
lines.zh: 三筆都很完美。你學得真快，凱！

choices.en: Thanks so much, Sam. I owe you one. Coffee's on me this afternoon.
choices.zh: 太感謝了，山姆，我欠你一次。今天下午的咖啡我請。
choices.tip: I owe you one. 表示「欠你一份人情」，再加一句請客，感謝更有誠意。

choices.en: Thank you, Sam. Next time I invite you. You can drink anything you want.
choices.zh: 謝謝你，山姆。下次我請你，你想喝什麼都可以。

lines.en: Invite me... to what? A party?

story.en: Sam waits all week for an invitation that never comes. He finally asks Nina if he missed a party.
story.zh: 山姆等了一整個星期都沒收到邀請，最後跑去問妮娜他是不是錯過了什麼派對。

fail.why: 「我請你」直譯成 I invite you，對方會以為你要邀他參加活動。說要請客要用 It's on me. 或 Coffee's on me.。

choices.en: Thank you, and sorry for troubling you so much. I'm so sorry, really, really sorry.
choices.zh: 謝謝你，真的很不好意思這麼麻煩你。對不起，真的真的很對不起。

lines.en: Hey, why are you sorry? Did something go wrong?
lines.zh: 嘿，你幹嘛道歉？出了什麼問題嗎？

story.en: Sam checks all three orders again, just in case. Now he thinks you broke something and are afraid to tell him.
story.zh: 山姆以防萬一，又把三筆訂單重新檢查一遍。他現在以為你弄壞了什麼，只是不敢說。

fail.why: 台灣人被幫忙時常說「不好意思」，但英文一直說 sorry 會讓對方以為出事了。被幫忙時多說 thanks，再加一句 I owe you one.。

lines.en: Deal! I'll take a large oat latte, please.
lines.zh: 成交！我要一杯大杯燕麥拿鐵，謝啦。

lines.en: That afternoon, you bring Sam his latte. The order system doesn't scare you anymore.
lines.zh: 那天下午，你把拿鐵送到山姆桌上。訂單系統再也嚇不倒你了。

story.en: You asked politely, learned fast, and said thank you the right way. Sam is now officially your work buddy.
story.zh: 你禮貌求助、學得快，也用對方式道謝。山姆正式成為你的職場好夥伴。

notes.explain: 打擾別人前先問這句，讓對方決定現在方不方便。比較口語的說法是 Got a sec?。

example.en: Do you have a minute? I have a quick question.
example.zh: 你有空一下嗎？我有個小問題。

notes.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could...
notes.explain: 很客氣的請求句型。appreciate 後面的 it 不能省略，說成 I will appreciate if... 是常見錯誤；用 could 比 can 更委婉。

example.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could review my draft.
example.zh: 如果你能幫我看一下草稿，我會很感激。

notes.explain: 對方幫了忙之後說，表示會找機會回報，語氣輕鬆友善。想請客可以接 Coffee's on me.。

example.en: Thanks for covering for me. I owe you one.
example.zh: 謝謝你幫我代班，我欠你一次。

notes.explain: invite 是「邀請參加活動」，不代表你要付錢。要請客說 It's on me.、My treat. 或 Lunch is on me.。

example.zh: 我們去吃晚餐吧，我請客！

notes.explain: 台灣人請人幫忙常一直說「不好意思」，但英文一直說 sorry 會讓對方以為出了什麼事。被幫忙時，說 Thanks so much. 或 I really appreciate it. 就好。

example.en: Thanks for your patience. I really appreciate it.
example.zh: 謝謝你的耐心，我真的很感激。
